rows.note: Use this for the everyday sense of successfully getting or obtaining something, especially a concrete or desired thing.

example.english: I finally managed to acquire a concert ticket.
example.traditional: 我終於攞到張演唱會飛喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 lo2 dou3 zoeng1 jin2 coeng3 wui2 fei1 laa3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose equivalent for obtaining something or gaining a result, benefit, or possession.

example.english: I finally managed to acquire a bonus.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 dak1 dou3 fan6 zoeng2 gam1 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically when acquiring knowledge or a skill through learning or practice, rather than merely obtaining an object.

example.english: I acquire lots of practical skills at this school.
example.traditional: 我喺呢間學校學到好多實用技能。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 ni1 gaan1 hok6 haau6 hok6 dou3 hou2 do1 sat6 jung6 gei6 nang4
